name: Breathless Winds
source:
Set in the lush and magical Two Elk Island, Poppy has long been recovering from an incident that left her bedridden, but her life changes when she finds herself at a crossroads between four branching paths. Will Poppy follow her family’s legacy as a sailor with help from her childhood friend, reunite with a former bully turned healer, prevent a calamity that threatens their island with a mysterious witch, or help the crown prince of the powerful Castle Island with a quest to save the king’s life?

[From [url=https://breathlesswinds.itch.io/breathless-winds]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在郁郁葱葱、充满魔法的Two Elk Island。Poppy一直在养病，过去的一场事故让她卧床不起；但当她站在人生的十字路口、面前出现4条分岔道路时，生活也随之改变。她会在青梅竹马的帮助下继承家族事业，成为水手；与曾经欺负过她、如今成了治疗师的人重逢；和一位神秘女巫联手阻止威胁岛屿的灾祸；还是帮助Castle Island的王子踏上旅程，拯救国王的性命？

[来源：[url=https://breathlesswinds.itch.io/breathless-winds]Itch.io[/url]]
